tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional Solution Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud & API Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional consultant with 5+ years of experience designing enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in bridging business requirements with technical architecture, specializing in RESTful API integrations, PIM/ERP data flows, and omnichannel commerce platforms. Proven track record in solution discovery, requirements engineering, and stakeholder management. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with deep expertise in Java, Spring, and microservices, leveraging AI-assisted analysis to deliver scalable, high-performance payment and commerce integrations.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Manager Solution Consulting
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Solution Consultant role at Planet. With over 5 years of experience delivering complex e-commerce and integration solutions for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my expertise in technical solution design and stakeholder management to your team.

bullets.label: Solution Discovery
bullets.text: I have extensive experience leading discovery sessions with international stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into functional specifications and robust technical architectures.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: I specialize in designing and implementing end-to-end data flows and RESTful API integrations, ensuring seamless connectivity between PIM, ERP, and commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acting as the bridge between business and engineering, I have successfully managed the full lifecycle of commerce solutions, from initial requirements gathering to production support.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Engagement
bullets.text: I am adept at delivering compelling technical demonstrations and solution designs that align platform capabilities with specific business objectives.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period and will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with Planet's mission.

tailoring.why_company: Planet's mission to create seamless, secure, and connected commerce experiences resonates with my professional background in building large-scale e-commerce platforms. I am impressed by Planet's growth and its commitment to transforming payment experiences for global merchants. I am eager to contribute my expertise in complex system integrations and techno-functional consulting to help Planet continue delivering exceptional value to its partners and customers.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by the challenge of bridging complex technical architectures with business needs. My goal is to leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce experience to drive high-impact solution design and seamless integration strategies within Planet's innovative payment ecosystem.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am a Senior Solution Consultant with 5+ years of experience in enterprise e-commerce and API integrations. I am very interested in the Senior Solution Consultant role at Planet and have just submitted my application. I would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Manager Solution Consulting - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Solution Consultant position at Planet. With over 5 years of experience in techno-functional consulting, API integrations, and enterprise e-commerce delivery, I am confident in my ability to support your commercial teams and drive successful solution designs. I am available to start on 16 December 2026 and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your requirements. Thank you for your time and consideration.
